subject: English
passage: Although one involves heat and one does ______ and exothermic reactions are both types of chemical processes—that is, they are reactions in which bonds between atoms are broken or formed.
prompt: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation: Choice B is the best answer. A comma is the appropriate way to link the dependent clause "Although...not" and the independent clause that follows.
